verdict.rationale: The docs cover most pieces of the story: ChatGPT can 'read files, analyze data' and 'analyze files' (chatgpt-docs-90, chatgpt-docs-66), make interactive visualizations (chatgpt-docs-29), and produce spreadsheets, documents and PDFs you can download (chatgpt-docs-30). Code execution is documented on the Codex side, which can run commands and work on local folders (chatgpt-docs-92, chatgpt-docs-16, chatgpt-docs-33), but no item explicitly says the assistant writes and runs code on your data to compute answers and charts. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an in-chat code-execution/data-analysis sandbox linking code runs to chart and file output, chart generation from user data specifically, and independent hands-on corroboration.
